content.short: Aave is a protocol that lets users borrow and lend with both fixed and variable interest rates.
content.description: Aave enables borrowing and lending across over 30 Ethereum-based assets. Users can switch between stable and variable interest rates and can access flash loans. The protocol also offers pools for real-world assets, including real estate, cargo and freight invoices, and payment advances enabled by its partner Centrifuge. Its governance token, AAVE, allows holders to participate in Aave Improvement Proposals (AIPs) and help shape the protocol's evolution.
content.meta: Aave is a DeFi lending protocol for borrowing and lending with flexible rates. Discover Aave and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Rebuilding securities finance on Aave V4
resources.tldr: Repo averages around $12.6 trillion in daily US exposures, almost all offchain. How V4's Hub and Spoke split could carry that machinery onchain.

resources.title: Unlimited Lending Market Structures
resources.tldr: Market structure decides who may borrow against what, and who absorbs the risk. Why V4 separates shared liquidity from the markets drawing on it.

resources.title: Why Chainlink CCIP Secures Aave Protocol and the Aave App
resources.tldr: Aave routes GHO transfers and governance over CCIP instead of its own bridge. Worth reading for what that assumes about cross-chain messaging.
